description: No local headcount is reported for most candidates. The Jan 27 health report counts 92 sit-in sites, not participants; search-only “hundreds” for teachers is not directly opened and does not give per-city counts; three Nador injuries do not establish crowd size.
required_followup: Seek contemporaneous local reporting, organizer statements or official records with event-specific attendance; keep threshold pending where unresolved.

description: Several relevant pages returned web-tool Cache miss/internal errors, zero lines, or technical difficulties. A normal HTTPS request to twelve Cache-miss pages failed locally before HTTP response due DNS resolution failure. RifDia returned HTTP 403 and was not retried. No protected access was attempted.
required_followup: Keep search-only pages as leads; use other open public sources if available. Do not retry/evade an actual 403 or infer that a cache miss is a site denial.

description: A search-only Hespress French item describes a health-professional action as “Wednesday 21 January 2021”; 21 January 2021 was not a Wednesday. Its event date and relationship to the Jan 27 sit-ins are unresolved.
required_followup: Retrieve the Jan 21 article or an independent contemporary report to confirm its publication/event date and distinguish it from Jan 27.

description: State target is unresolved for private-contractor or company grievances in Oujda, Khenifra and the Karama lead. For the Marrakech school security/cleaning action, AMDH calls for state intervention in a solidarity passage but does not attribute that appeal to the protesters. Public-office locations, a human-rights appeal or state force do not by themselves prove a protester policy demand.
required_followup: Find organizers’ demand statements and identify whether they sought state action/policy or only employer compliance; for Marrakech, distinguish protesters’ own demands from AMDH’s solidarity appeal.

description: National teacher actions in two cities, repeated unemployed-graduate actions across dates, the ongoing Oujda picket program, and health-worker actions need cross-month and original-rule episode review. Distinct organized events should not be merged merely because dates/issues align.
required_followup: Review December 2020 and February 2021 reporting and consult the additional official Coding Procedure before coordinator decisions.

description: Discovery and direct reading covered Arabic and French, plus English searches; one exploratory Tifinagh/Amazigh-form query produced no relevant Moroccan source, so systematic Tamazight/Amazigh-language coverage remains absent. Arabic/French machine translations and source independence remain limits.
required_followup: Review original-language articles and search relevant Amazigh-language sources where available; do not substitute translations for original phrasing.

description: The 22 literal searches cover general and weekly windows, health/education/labor sectors, named cities, postal workers, hammam professionals and one exploratory Tifinagh/Amazigh form. The search service returned pooled batches that could not be assigned fully to individual queries, and no search outcome establishes absence.
required_followup: Continue weekly, city/region and sector searches, retain literal query logs, and describe uncovered regions/languages; do not claim exhaustiveness.

description: The opened Annahj issue is an advocacy/party weekly that covers several events; AMDH is an organization report; some other event details exist only as snippets possibly relying on organizer/local media statements. These are source leads, not independent corroboration.
required_followup: Trace each source’s origin and seek contemporaneous independent reporting; preserve the single-source status.

description: Physical end dates are not established for most actions. The health article mentions a two-hour action but not departure; the Sidi Bennour occupation was displaced and resumed Jan 28; the Amanour onset is only described as day 360 on Jan 14.
required_followup: Follow each activity until a physical end is documented or retain null; do not treat last article or month-end as the end.

description: An opened Hespress report confirms a Jan 15 postal-workers sit-in in Rabat after a planned demonstration outside the postal headquarters was prevented, but gives no attendance count and does not identify who prevented it or which state office the sit-in petitioned. Search-only reports suggest other postal pickets on Jan 8, 12 and 14 in several cities while the strike continued; do not combine these dates or use workforce/strike counts as crowd size.
required_followup: Seek city-specific reports or union statements with attendance, exact picket dates, intended state target and actual state actor at the Jan 15 interruption; determine whether each date is a separate event and whether the strike episode has a distinct unit.

description: The opened Annahj weekly issue mentions a Benslimane family encamped outside the agriculture directorate and a solidarity visit by union, human-rights and local supporters regarding threatened land transfer. The article does not give the action date, crowd size, onset or departure, so January ownership and the public-assembly threshold cannot be established.
required_followup: Find contemporaneous Benslimane reporting or family/AMDH statements establishing the camp and solidarity visit dates, whether the family encampment was joined by a public gathering of at least 50, the demand to Moroccan authorities and the camp’s physical end.

description: Multiple reports say authorities prohibited a planned Jan 21 sit-in by hammam professionals outside the Casablanca-Settat Wilaya against prolonged closure. One search-only report says owners decided to hold a sit-in that morning, but no opened source confirms a crowd assembled and there is no attendance estimate; event occurrence and threshold remain unresolved.
required_followup: Open the Jan 21 same-day reports and seek direct union/organizer evidence that a public assembly actually formed, its attendance, the organizer, exact government target, and any physical intervention.

description: Yabiladi directly reports a Dec 17 2020 open-ended Jbel Aouam miners’ strike and sit-in involving 300 workers (100 underground, 200 surface) with safety and agreement demands. No January report or physical end was found in this pass, so continued presence in January cannot be assumed and the December headcounts do not apply to this unit.
required_followup: Search January 2021 news/union sources for the mine workers’ continuing strike, physical end, and any separate public gatherings; retain only as a continuation if January presence is documented.

description: AMDH reports a Jan 26 action by school security agents and women cleaners in Marrakech and separately calls for state intervention regarding outsourced workers’ rights. The solidarity appeal is not clearly the protesters’ own demand. No attendance count, exact school/public assembly site, named organizer, physical end or state response is given; both the domestic-state target and 50-person threshold remain unresolved.
required_followup: Seek contemporaneous Marrakech reporting or organizer evidence for protesters’ own state-directed demand, attendance, exact site, organizer, physical end and state response; do not merge with the separately reported Oujda action without evidence.
